questions.stem: A drawing pin is dropped $500$ times and lands point-up $320$ times. Using relative frequency, estimate the probability of landing point-up.
questions.explanation: Relative frequency $= \frac{320}{500} = 0.64$. This is the best estimate of the probability from the experiment.

questions.stem: The relative frequency of rolling a $3$ on a biased die is $0.2$. In $150$ rolls, how many times would you expect to get a $3$?
